data.title: Modular Spaceships and Space Fleet
data.summary: Original socketed hulls with modular equipment, station structures, utility craft and debris.
data.description: Static detailed geometry in metres with +Y up, +Z bow. Ship hulls rest on skid frames. Four named socket families accept engines, weapons, sensors and cargo. Codex continuation of the recovered Claude brief.
